# D2RLoader PluginSDK 0.4.0 upstream pin

This directory vendors the official public header surface used to build this
plugin against Plugin ABI 4.

- Repository: https://github.com/D2RLoader/PluginSDK
- SDK release: `0.4.0`
- Plugin ABI: `4`
- Upstream branch: `master`
- Commit: `03a5af9e0feb3f95f95e148e330e01f6635950df`
- License: MIT; see `LICENSE`

The files in `include/D2RLPlugin/` and `LICENSE` are copied from that commit.
The upstream repository did not publish a `v0.4.0` tag when this pin was
created, so the commit hash identifies the exact source snapshot.
